title: Trader Diary: BTC at $83,932 & My 1‑minute Panic Button
content:
- 8:00 PM: “Just a tiny 0.2% dip, I’ll buy the dip… again.”
- 8:01 PM: Leverage 5x, heart rate 180 BPM.
- 8:05 PM: “Why is the chart screaming louder than my mom’s group chat?”
lesson: If the price moves more than your coffee temperature, step back and lower the leverage.
question: Who else hit the ‘add more leverage’ button at 0.2%? Be honest 👇
